title: Firm panels, timestamps and prediction availability
citation: Grunfeld; 11-firm reconstruction documented by Kleiber and Zeileis (2008); statsmodels distribution.
observation_unit: One firm-year record. A repeated firm is not a new independent company.
scope_limitations: 220 rows; 11 firms, 1935–1954. Historical data, not investment advice or current-market evidence.
acquisition: offline export from installed package distribution; no invented records
transforms: Preserved loaded values and row order; added zero-based row_id.
Calendar fields cast to integers; CO2 datetime index exported as ISO date.
Missing CO2 observations remain blank, never zero.

schema.name: row_id
schema.units: source scale; see data card (not guessed)

schema.name: invest
schema.description: Gross investment; no additional millions multiplier is assumed.

schema.name: value
schema.description: Year-end market value; not available at the beginning of that same year.
